question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT about the characteristic features of the Indian Desert?

options.text: It is also known as Marusthali.
It lies northwest of the Aravalli hills.
It receives 250 mm rainfall per year.

solution:
The answer is **__Option 3__.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The only desert found in India is the Thar Desert which is present in **Rajasthan**.
 
• It receives very low rainfall that is** below 150mm per year.**
 
• It is also known as **Marusthali since it is an undulating sandy plain that has infertile soil.**
 
• It lies northwest of Aravalli hills with a very extreme climate of hot days and cold nights .
 
• It has a semiarid plain of sand with an ample amount of sand dunes and **Luni is the largest river **in the desert.
 
• It is one of the **world's most densely populated **deserts.
